About The Opportunity 

 A leading IT services and cloud consulting firm operating in enterprise cloud transformation, SaaS delivery, and digital infrastructure for global customers. We architect secure, scalable cloud platforms and run large-scale migrations, cloud-native re-platforming, and managed cloud operations across public and hybrid environments. 

 We are hiring a Lead Cloud Architect to own cloud strategy and delivery for enterprise accounts. This is an on-site role based in Noida, India. 

 Role & Responsibilities 

 Define and lead cloud architecture strategy across public and hybrid environments; translate business requirements into scalable, secure cloud solutions.  Design, review, and approve reference architectures, migration plans, and landing zones using IaC (Terraform/ARM/Bicep) and container orchestration patterns.  Drive multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud implementations (AWS/Azure/GCP), including networking (VPC/VNet), identity/IAM, security controls, and governance frameworks.  Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to implement CI/CD, observability, cost controls, and automated deployment pipelines; enforce cloud best practices.  Lead technical assessments, proof-of-concepts, and architecture reviews; provide technical leadership and mentor senior engineers and architects.  Engage with stakeholders and customers to present solutions, manage risks, and ensure alignment to enterprise compliance, security, and cost objectives. 

 Skills & Qualifications 

 Must-Have 

10+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, cloud engineering, or related roles with demonstrable lead architect experience.  Proven hands-on experience designing and delivering solutions on AWS, Azure, and/or GCP at enterprise scale.  Deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/ARM/Bicep), containerization (Kubernetes/Docker), and CI/CD pipelines.  Strong knowledge of cloud networking, identity & access management, security controls, and compliance frameworks.  Experience with cloud migration strategies, re-platforming, and operational runbooks for resiliency and incident response.  Track record of technical leadership: architecture reviews, POCs, stakeholder presentations, and mentoring senior engineers. 

 Preferred 

 AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Google Professional Cloud Architect.  Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) and automated cost optimization tooling.  Background in FinTech, SaaS, or large-scale enterprise modernization projects. 

 Benefits & Culture Highlights 

 Opportunity to lead high-visibility cloud transformations and influence enterprise cloud strategy.  Collaborative, engineering-driven culture with focus on continuous learning and hands-on mentorship.  Competitive compensation and on-site role based in Noida with exposure to global customers. 

 Primary Title: Lead Cloud Architect 

 Location: Noida, India (On-site) Skills: microservices architecture,aws,terraform,kubernetes,cloud security,google cloud platform .

SourceFuse Technologies hiring Senior Cloud Migration Engineer / Architect (AWS to GCP Migration) with 6+ years of experience.




Preferred Location- Noida/Mohali

Key Responsibilities

Migration Strategy and Delivery Leadership

Own the end to end technical strategy for the AWS to GCP migration, including target architecture, migration sequencing, and cutover approach.Produce and maintain the Technical Design Document (TDD), including low level component diagrams, at a level of detail a client engineering team can implement against.Establish and maintain a Key Design Decision (KDD) log capturing the rationale for major architecture choices, for example service equivalency decisions such as Cloud Run versus other compute options.Build and maintain a Migration and Rollback Plan, and an accurate, current Component Inventory of everything in scope for migration.Run weekly governance and status reporting, and maintain a Deliverables and Acceptances Log so the client always has a clear, current record of what has been delivered and approved.


Migration Execution

Diagnose and resolve codebase divergence between environments, including establishing a snapshot and reconciliation approach where none currently exists.Lead migration of core services, including compute, container workloads, and identity/authentication, from the source cloud to GCP equivalents.Own data migration validation where the target uses a different database engine than the source (for example, a document or key-value store migration such as DynamoDB to Firestore), including building or reviewing validation scripts and consistency reports.Define and implement a cross-cloud connectivity approach (private networking between environments) for the duration of the migration.Define the scope and implementation of any cross-cloud abstraction layer required to keep the platform portable during and after migration.Plan and execute large scale data and feed migrations (dozens of independent feeds or integrations), with a clear enablement and validation package for each.Migrate logging and observability tooling, for example a self-managed ELK stack, to GCP native or GCP-compatible equivalents, with log routing fully validated before cutover.


Infrastructure and Compatibility

Build and maintain the target GCP landing zone and core infrastructure using IaC, Terraform preferred, so environments are repeatable, reviewable, and version controlled.Own the CI/CD pipeline build for the new environment.Drive remediation of the service compatibility assessment, translating flagged incompatible services into a prioritized, sequenced backlog ahead of cutover.Review pull requests from client engineers where the client team is doing migration work in parallel, and keep that work aligned to the agreed target design.


Cutover and Post-Migration

Plan and lead the production cutover, including go and no go criteria, rollback triggers, and a data consistency and parity validation approach.Produce platform documentation and operational runbooks, and lead technical handover and enablement sessions for the client's internal team.Provide a defined period of post-cutover expert advisory support, including an operational protocol and escalation matrix.


Required Skills and Experience

Proven experience leading at least one large scale, production cloud migration end to end, from planning through cutover, ideally cross-cloud.Deep, hands on GCP experience across compute (Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, App Engine), data and storage (Firestore, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, Bigtable, Memorystore), and networking (VPC, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud NAT, Cloud DNS).Working familiarity with AWS is useful for reading and reasoning about the source environment, for example Cognito, DynamoDB, and Lambda, though deep AWS expertise is not required for this role.Advanced Terraform experience, including reusable modules, state management, and automated deployment workflows.Experience migrating between different database engines, including designing or validating data consistency and correctness checks.Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed systems, using Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Audit Logs for root cause analysis.Demonstrated ability to write clear technical design documentation, and to run structured governance and status reporting for a client or stakeholder audience.Comfortable owning ambiguous, partially defined scope and turning it into a documented, sequenced plan under time pressure.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience migrating identity and authentication between cloud providers, for example Cognito to an equivalent GCP or third party identity service.Experience migrating self-managed Elasticsearch or ELK deployments to managed or cloud native alternatives.Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals, such as IAM, least privilege, Secret Manager, and VPC Service Controls, sufficient to keep the migrated environment secure by design. This is not primarily a security hardening role.Experience standing up a post go-live managed services capability: ongoing monitoring, operational efficiency improvements, and automated operational actions.Experience with data sovereignty sensitive or regulated workloads, and with multi-region deployments.

We are seeking an experienced Azure Cloud Solutions Architect with deep expertise in Azure Cloud Architecture, Database Administration (DBA), Cloud Data Platforms, Database Migration, Infrastructure Modernization, and Enterprise Cloud Transformation. The ideal candidate will lead the design, architecture, and implementation of scalable, secure, and highly available Azure cloud solutions while driving large-scale database modernization initiatives.


The candidate should possess extensive experience migrating enterprise databases including SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB to Azure, designing High Availability (HA) and Disaster Recovery (DR) architectures, implementing Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), building CI/CD automation, and optimizing cloud performance, scalability, and cost. This role requires close collaboration with infrastructure, application, security, DevOps, and data engineering teams to deliver cloud-native, business-critical solutions.


Key Roles & Responsibilities


Azure Cloud Architecture

Design enterprise-scale Azure cloud architectures aligned with business, security, and operational requirements.
Develop cloud adoption and modernization strategies for enterprise applications and databases.
Define Azure landing zones, governance models, networking, identity management, and security architecture.
Architect scalable, resilient, and highly available cloud infrastructure using Azure best practices.
Evaluate existing on-premises environments and recommend cloud-native modernization approaches.

Database Architecture & Migration

Lead enterprise database migration projects from SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB to Azure cloud platforms.
Design migration strategies with minimal downtime and business disruption.
Perform database assessments, dependency analysis, migration planning, and execution.
Optimize migrated databases for performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
Establish backup, recovery, maintenance, and lifecycle management strategies.
Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance throughout migration activities.

High Availability & Disaster Recovery

Design and implement enterprise HA/DR architectures for mission-critical workloads.
Develop business continuity strategies using Azure-native disaster recovery services.
Configure geo-redundancy, replication, backup automation, failover, and recovery procedures.
Conduct disaster recovery planning, testing, and documentation.
Ensure Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) and Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) meet business requirements.

Azure Data Platform & Integration

Design scalable data integration architectures using Azure Data Factory (ADF).
Develop secure data movement strategies between on-premises and cloud environments.
Build enterprise data migration and synchronization pipelines.
Integrate databases with analytics, reporting, AI, and business applications.
Support hybrid cloud and multi-database integration scenarios.

Infrastructure Automation & DevOps

Implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
Build reusable Terraform modules for Azure infrastructure provisioning.
Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and database deployments.
Automate cloud provisioning, configuration management, deployments, and operational tasks.
Integrate DevOps practices into enterprise cloud delivery processes.

Performance Optimization & Capacity Planning

Perform database performance tuning, workload optimization, and query analysis.
Monitor Azure resource utilization and optimize compute, storage, and networking.
Develop capacity planning models for enterprise growth and workload forecasting.
Recommend right-sizing strategies to improve cloud efficiency and reduce operational costs.
Optimize application and database performance across cloud environments.

Governance, Security & Compliance

Implement Azure governance using policies, resource organization, tagging, and management groups.
Design secure architectures utilizing Azure Identity, RBAC, Key Vault, and network security controls.
Ensure compliance with enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements.
Conduct architecture reviews and cloud security assessments.
Implement monitoring, logging, auditing, and operational dashboards.

Leadership & Collaboration

Provide architectural leadership and technical guidance to engineering teams.
Mentor cloud engineers, database administrators, and DevOps professionals.
